# Reva Hristo Wiki Fonseca

> AIOps Builder · DevOps Expert · Cloud Specialist — transforming traditional IT operations into a highly automated ecosystem

## Summary

IT infrastructure and AIOps specialist based in Bogor, Indonesia. 7+ years across
cloud infrastructure, DevOps, and — most recently — agentic AI applied to IT
operations. Most recently led AIOps R&D for a major Indonesian telco at Tech
Mahindra. Focused on making operations resilient enough that engineers build
instead of firefight.

## Core Competencies

- **AIOps & AI Automation:** agent swarms, RAG & knowledge bases, MCP servers, human-in-the-loop, guardrails
- **Cloud Architecture:** hybrid and multi-cloud design, container orchestration, cost optimization
- **Infrastructure as Code:** Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, config-driven provisioning, drift elimination
- **Observability & SRE:** metrics, logs, traces, SLO design, anomaly detection, incident response
- **CI/CD & DevSecOps:** GitOps workflow, zero-downtime deploys, pipeline-integrated security scanning
- **Enablement:** runbooks, SOPs, internal tooling, training

## Work Experience

### Tech Mahindra (Jan 2025 - Aug 2026) — Senior System Engineer
Led AIOps R&D for a major Indonesian telco.
- Built a unified L1 copilot correlating monitoring, ITSM/CMDB, docs, and comms into one triage layer
- Led an R&D team of 4 building AI-driven automation across 20+ AWS accounts and 10+ Kubernetes clusters
- Automatic anomaly detection cut MTTD from ~20 to <=5 minutes; AI-assisted first-level RCA cut MTTR from ~30 to <=10 minutes
- Automatic MOP (Method-of-Procedure) checker cut review cycles ~60 -> ~20 minutes and raised throughput from 1-2 to 4+ change requests/day
- Automatic AWS Direct Connect failover eliminated manual switchover, preventing IDR 79B+ in yearly revenue loss from recurrent fiber-optic outages
- Recognized as Innovator of the Month by Tech Mahindra's Chief People Officer, June 2025
- Case study: https://revawiki.io/case-study-copilot.html

### PT HM Sampoerna Tbk. (2024) — Senior DevOps Engineer
Philip Morris International group (tobacco industry, not pharma). Owned SLAs
while migrating legacy AWS accounts onto compliant GitOps provisioning.
- Led a team of 7 engineers through the console-to-Terraform migration of the company's flagship application across dev/staging/production
- Replaced per-environment HCL with one codebase driven by per-environment YAML (for_each + TF_VAR_env)
- Standardized inherited legacy AWS account configurations to PMI global compliance
- Reduced AWS infrastructure cost for the SEA region ~55% via rightsizing, reservation optimization and eliminating redundant resources
- Eliminated 1-2 hours of daily repetitive service-request work through targeted Jenkins automations
- Case study: https://revawiki.io/case-study-terraform.html

### PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk (2022 - 2024) — DevOps Lead
Netmonk product. Promoted to lead the DevOps team of 4 engineers.
- Architected a multi-tenant AWS ECS platform replacing 100+ single-tenant EC2 instances, leading the team of 4 through the re-architecture
- Cut AWS infrastructure cost ~70%
- Migrated from AWS Singapore to the new AWS Jakarta region
- Halved deploy time (10 -> 5 min) via DevSecOps-integrated Bitbucket pipeline
- Case study: https://revawiki.io/case-study-ecs.html

### PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk (2020 - 2022) — Technical Support Engineer
- Reduced deployment time from ~40 to ~10 minutes through Terraform + Ansible provisioned pipelines
- Reduced MTTR from ~30 to ~15 minutes by implementing a Grafana-based observability system

### BRIN — National Research & Innovation Agency (2019 - 2020) — System Administrator
- Rebuilt legacy HPC lab infrastructure by repairing 20+ broken nodes, avoiding new hardware purchases
- Implemented Puppet configuration management, ensuring consistency across 40+ HPC nodes

### PT Griya Mitra Persada (2018) — IT Support Lead
- Led a team of 5 across 50+ end-devices throughout the Asian Games 2018 event

## Published Case Studies

- [Unified L1 Copilot Platform](https://revawiki.io/case-study-copilot.html): RAG + MCP + human-in-the-loop across 20+ AWS accounts. MTTD ~20 -> <=5 min, MTTR ~30 -> <=10 min, change throughput 1-2 -> 4+/day
- [AWS DX Auto-Failover](https://revawiki.io/case-study-dx-failover.html): automated physical-layer failover, IDR 79B+ yearly revenue loss prevented. Code: github.com/revawiki/aws-direct-connect-auto-failover
- [YAML-based Terraform Standardization](https://revawiki.io/case-study-terraform.html): one codebase, per-environment YAML config, 100% of the flagship application's resources on Terraform, routine changes without touching HCL
- [Multi-Tenant AWS ECS Platform Migration](https://revawiki.io/case-study-ecs.html): 100+ EC2 deployments consolidated, ~70% cost reduction, 2x faster deploys
- [Jenkins to CloudBees Pipeline Migration](https://revawiki.io/case-study-cloudbees.html): 100+ pipelines migrated across 3 environments in 4 weeks (vs a 12-week manual plan) via a Jinja2 Jenkinsfile template and a Python migration script
- [Dynamic EC2 Provisioning with Golden AMIs](https://revawiki.io/case-study-golden-ami.html): golden AMI pipeline + Terraform/Ansible provisioning via Bitbucket CI, deployment cut from ~40 to ~10 minutes

## About This Site

Interactive CV with a serverless Claude chatbot. Static frontend on S3/CloudFront,
FastAPI on AWS Lambda behind API Gateway (via Mangum), API key in Secrets Manager,
all provisioned with AWS CDK in Python.
